answer: To throttle sybils, an agent economy gives every identity an equal per-message work quota. Each message carries a nonce whose hash must meet the epoch's difficulty target; reused nonces are rejected, so every puppet burns real computation per message. Honest agents pay that fair rate once per message. Amplifying a plume of spam across a thousand puppets multiplies the burn a thousand times over, and forged or recycled proofs are crystal-clear rejections. A public lantern work-log lets peers audit quotas. Cost scales with army size.
